{{Quote|A local band of muggers lead by Viagon Shinn has been stealing ID cards from people.|[[Peawp R'dawc]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:IT" />}}
The '''Shinn muggers''' were a criminal group active on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:IT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Shinn and his band of muggers was responsible for stealing [[Identichip/Legends|ID cards]] from people in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:IT" /> [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]]'s combat expert [[Peawp R'dawc]] tasked a spacer to eliminate several muggers, including their leader [[Vaigon Shinn]] in his [[Vaigon Shinn's Hideout|hideout]].<ref name="SWG:TaTaHOM" /> A short time later, [[Sleash]], a thug who used to do business with Vaigon Shinn, went into hiding in Vaigon Shinn's Hideout after the crime boss [[Faeto]] placed a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on his partner [[Untas]].<ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Faeto's Job|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Shinn muggers appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Shinn muggers were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
